The carton job pipeline

One Customer Product Spec drives one Job Card which renders one multi-page traveller PDF. Traveller runs and resource consumption capture the floor reality. Daily Plan rolls multiple Job Cards into the day's schedule.

Figure 1. The CPS → Job Card → Print Format pipeline, with Traveller / Resource child tables feeding the PPC layer.

The carton calculation chain (the hard bit)

  1. Ply rules — CPS fields toggle on ply (3 → layers 1-3, 5 → 1-5, SFK → 1-2) and on product_type.
  2. SFK UI — the special-board UI for SFK ply types.
  3. Flap auto-calc — Tray, 1-Flap, 2-Flap, 3-Flap, RSC geometry formulas in vcl_calc_board_sizes_serial.
  4. Board sizes — planned + actual width × length, both planned by the spec and actual measured on-floor.
  5. Weight calc — derived from board sizes + GSM per layer.
  6. Print format — 4-6 pages: Job Card, Carton Layout (full-width die-cut SVG), Station Log (Jinja loop over Traveller Runs), Resources (planned vs actual + variance).

VCL Production · Reporting flowspage 06 · 28 may 2026

The 17:00 Gemba flow

The end-of-day Gemba report is a per-job-card-type summary (closed, in-progress, on-hold, blocked) auto-generated at 17:00 EAT and pushed to Tanuj on Telegram. The Frappe Cloud site doesn't hold the Telegram bot token — n8n does — so the flow is intentionally split.

Figure 2. The Gemba report path. Frappe builds the PDF, n8n owns the credentials and the multipart upload.

Implementation details

  • Scheduler: 17:00 EAT entry in production_log/hooks.py calling generate_eod_report.
  • Per-doctype profile (JCL_PROFILE): different job-card schemas (e.g. ETR uses status + delivery_date; Carton/Label use job_status) get aliased in the SQL so one report template covers all four.
  • Webhook: https://vcl-intranet.tailb2b755.ts.net/webhook/gemba-telegram — n8n workflow vclGembaTelegram001.
  • Token: stays in n8n's environment ($env read inside the Code node). No Frappe site_config secret.
  • Default chat: 8566637123 (Tanuj). Override via site_config gemba_chat_id only if needed.

What still blocks the flow on prod

ItemWhy it matters
site_config.telegram_bot_tokenRequired only for the legacy direct-Telegram path — now bypassed via n8n. Keep absent or remove.
site_config.gemba_channel_chat_idOptional. Defaults to Tanuj's personal chat if absent. Set if you want to push to a group instead.

Bigger questions

Q1. Production-execution layer — removed in v3. Was the new traveller + resource model enough, or do we need a slim version of Daily Production Log / Production Entry back (e.g. for cumulative WIP across days)?
Q2. Carton job-card releases — the 5 readiness Check fields (plate_ready, material_in_stock, customer_hold, artwork_approved, plates_lead_time_clear) are on every job-card type but nothing gates submit on them yet. Should they gate submit, or just be informational in a Release Plan view?
Q3. Carton ply-7 / ply-9 — current GSM toggles handle 3, 5, SFK. Anything heavier needed for export packaging?
Q4. Should the PPC reports live on a dashboard (single page, side-by-side charts) instead of separate report URLs?
